name: empty-penguin
description: A 70 by 36 neo-brutalist on/off switch: 100px pill track, 2px ink border, 4px offset shadow, and a labeled thumb that slides the well.
purpose: Lets people flip a single persistent setting with the Uiverse empty-penguin motion, without flattening the 100px radii.
bestFor: playful form rows that need an on/off caption in the thumb
feature flags in light product UI
